- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:618-662 | severity=low | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: `ORCHESTRATE_DECOMPOSER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MAX_SECS=3000` is hardcoded without being linked to the job timeout or attempt-budget math.
  WHY: The reviewer said future reductions to the job timeout could leave the clamp oversized relative to the available budget.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:636-645 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The integer validation regex rejects `0` but still allows some zero-padded forms, and it does not log zero rejection explicitly.
  WHY: The reviewer said invalid input falls back to 3000 with only a generic warning, so the operator does not see a specific zero-rejection message.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:749-784 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `CODEX_PROMPT_FILE` is not rebuilt from `BASE_PROMPT_FILE` on the timeout path, so stale retry feedback can carry into the next attempt.
  WHY: The reviewer said this is pre-existing and not harmful because the feedback is still relevant context, but it means the PR description overstates the rebuild behavior.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:766-787 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Exit code 137 is classified as timeout even though it can also mean OOM killer or external `kill -9`.
  WHY: deepseek treats this as diagnostic-only, while qwen/x-ai say it can waste retries and mislead operators on genuine OOM/external kills; severity is set to the higher-impact reports.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:777-785 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop does not restore the working tree after a timeout, so a killed codex run can leave partial edits for the next attempt.
  WHY: Because codex runs with `--sandbox danger-full-access`, attempt N+1 can start from a dirty tree rather than the baseline, which can corrupt subsequent patching or analysis.
- README.md:919-925 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The new environment-variable documentation repeats implementation details instead of staying at the usage level.
  WHY: The reviewer said readers may have to cross-reference the workflow file to understand the override and clamp semantics.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
